exactCanonicalSetting.sourceObservedSetting: cohort.lt40_excluded: {"participants":2,"rule":"fewer than 40 emotion samples during entire period"}
exactCanonicalSetting.sourceClause: 2 participants entered less than 40 emotion samples during entire period; data from the remaining participants were retained

inputBoundary: One caller-supplied nonnegative integer count of emotion labels entered by one participant over the complete study period; constructing that count from keyboard, survey, or session records occurs before this gate.
outputBoundary: Exclude a participant only when the complete-period emotion-label count is strictly less than 40; retain equality and larger counts.
limitations: This binding does not identify, deduplicate, or count emotion-label records and does not infer the start or end of the study period.
A missing participant count fails closed; no zero count or partial-period count is synthesized.
The four mid-study dropouts are a separate cohort decision and are not classified by this threshold.
No Response session elimination, the separate less-than-80-touch session filter, and per-user SMOTE are adjacent operations outside this participant-level gate.
The source reports that two participants met the exclusion rule; that empirical total is not treated as a required output of an arbitrary fixture.
The generic scalar bucketizer accepts finite real values, but this source binding requires a nonnegative integer count before invoking it.
